criteria: mentions the missing null check on `hero` before accessing `hero.powerstats` — if no hero matches the ID the code will throw a TypeError
suggests returning a 404 response when the hero is not found
notes that `Object.values(stats).reduce(...)` can produce NaN if any powerstat value is null or undefined
flags the hardcoded port number 41071 — it should read from `process.env.PORT` to remain configurable across environments
warns that `cors({ origin: '*' })` allows any origin, which is too permissive for production and should be restricted to known frontend origins
points out that `app.use(cors(...))` is added after the app is already created and routes may already be mounted, so the middleware ordering could cause CORS headers to be missing on some requests

flags that `req.query.name` is typed as `string | string[] | ParsedQs | ParsedQs[] | undefined` and is used without any validation — if `name` is omitted or not a plain string the call to `.toLowerCase()` will throw
suggests checking that `req.query.name` is present and is a string, and returning a 400 error otherwise
notes that `loadHeroes()` is called on every search request without caching, which duplicates the same concern present on other routes
